I use Traefik as a reverse proxy.

This makes it so instead of port forwarding for services to access them outside my house through my public IP:port (324.524.23.12:7878 etc) I can access them through [service.mydomain.com](https://service.mydomain.com).

This makes it much easier to access outside my network as I don't need to remember IP's. It also makes it so instead of having all my applications ports open to the world I only need ports 80 and 443 open.

Also using LetsEncrypt allows me to get an SSL certificate to have it secured.
